name: Domain certificates
description: Every hour: a TLS handshake against our own edge for every domain every project serves (its hosted name and its own domains), recording the certificate that comes back — expiry, subject, issuer — or the failure in the handshake's own words, one row per domain (domaincert). The project reports dashboard, the project card and the Builder's board read it; a certificate within 14 days of expiry or a name the served certificate does not cover shows as a warning. scripts/domain-certs.php, lib/DomainCerts.php.
